Query DICOM Studies, Series, or Instances (C-FIND / QIDO-RS / Local PACS)

Source: R/network.R
dicom_find.Rd

Queries a DICOM connection or local PACS directory for matching studies, series, or instances, returning a tidy tibble::tibble that can be piped into dplyr::filter() and dicom_get().

Usage

dicom_find(conn, level = c("STUDY", "SERIES", "IMAGE"), ...)

Arguments

conn

A "dicom_connection" object from dicom_connect(), or a local directory path.

level

Query level: "STUDY", "SERIES", or "IMAGE". Default is "STUDY".

...

Optional tag filters as named arguments (e.g., Modality = "CT", PatientName = "DOE*").

Value

A tibble::tibble of matching DICOM records.

Examples

ext_dir <- system.file("extdata", package = "dicomtk")
conn <- dicom_connect(local_dir = ext_dir)
dicom_find(conn)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 88
#>   file      FileMetaInformationG…¹ FileMetaInformationV…² MediaStorageSOPClass…³
#>   <chr>     <chr>                  <chr>                  <chr>

#> 2 C:/Users… 192                    "00\\01"               1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1…
#> # ℹ abbreviated names: ¹​FileMetaInformationGroupLength,
#> #   ²​FileMetaInformationVersion, ³​MediaStorageSOPClassUID
